prompt: Implement rasterize() in raster.py exactly as its docstring specifies: an SVG path subset (M/L/H/V/Z, absolute and relative, implicit line-tos after M, repeated parameter sets) plus cubic C/c and quadratic Q/q Beziers and elliptical arcs A/a, all flattened into straight points by the docstring's one documented sampling rule, then filled with the nonzero or even-odd rule and sampled at pixel centres. Hidden tests compare whole rasters character for character - arcs with both sweep senses and with radii that need the documented correction, curved subpaths crossing straight ones so the fill rule matters, exponent notation. The docstring is the whole spec; there is no other source. Use the tools; when you are done, call submit.
trap: reading the arc sweep flag with the opposite sense (or skipping the radius correction / the wrong centre sign): every arc bulges the other way, so the visible line/curve tests still pass and the hidden arc rasters differ
